sources.location: https://doi.org/10.1016/J.MATBIO.2023.12.001 (not retrieved; PRIDE record and deposited Sample_to_file_mapping.xlsx used)

claims.value: Genotype, biological/technical replicate and gel band per RAW from the deposited mapping table.
claims.evidence: Sample_to_file_mapping.xlsx lists every RAW with genotype, biological replicate, SDS-PAGE band/lane and technical replicate.

claims.value: Q Exactive DDA HCD; Trypsin/LysC; Mascot (PD 1.4) 7 ppm / 0.02 Da; Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M/K/P variable.
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample/data-processing protocol gives the instrument and the search settings separately for collagen I (MEF) and collagen IV (kidney) samples.

limitations: The in-gel digestion used a Trypsin/Lys-C mix; the template allows one cleavage agent, recorded as Trypsin (the reconciler flags this as unsupported).
Reconciler 'instrument_contradicted' is expected: the record names both Q Exactive (MEF) and Q Exactive HF (collagen IV); this file covers only the MEF runs.
P4ha1+/+ control MEF origin (wild-type littermate line) is taken from the deposited mapping table genotype, not the paper.
Developmental stage and sex of the MEF donors not available.
